LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Supremacist: Why work when you can make others do it? Slaves aren't cruelty, they're delegation. Neighbors hate you, but that's their problem.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_MaleSupremacy: Real men run the colony. Women? Sure, but not too many. Patriarchy — tested through the ages.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_FemaleSupremacy: Men are useful, but women should be in charge. Matriarchy isn't a trend, it's common sense.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Nudism: Pants are for the weak. A true colonist needs only sunshine and confidence. Winter is trickier, but faith keeps you warm.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_PainIsVirtue: Pain is just weakness leaving the body. And scars are life's tattoos. Free of charge. Sometimes painful. Always spiritual.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_HighLife: Sobriety is a disease. Luckily, there's plenty of medicine. Pills, smoke, injections — every dose brings you closer to nirvana. Rehab? No, we have a preacher.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Cannibal: Waste not, want not. Eco-friendly, economical, and the fridge line got shorter. Guests stopped visiting for some reason.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_NaturePrimacy: Nature gave you everything — air, food, wood... wait, don't touch the wood! Plant, water, admire. Buy firewood from the neighbors.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Blindsight: Why have eyes when you can see with your soul? Sure, your colonists will bump into walls at first. But then... then they'll see things the sighted could never dream of.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Darkness: Night vision isn't a mutation, it's a lifestyle. While others stumble in the dark, your people dance there. Well, or fight. Usually fight.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Tunneler: Windows are an architectural mistake. Doors are a forced necessity. The ideal room has neither. Just three layers of granite all around.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Proselytizer: Colony-cult? How dare you. Colony-family! Just with mandatory membership. And weekly sermons. And no exit policy.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Transhumanist: The body is a rough draft. The final version includes a titanium skeleton, bionic eyes, and a couple extra arms. Factory reset is impossible. And unnecessary.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_FleshPurity: No implants, no prosthetics, no synthetics. The body is given by nature and changing it is a sin. The only upgrade allowed — good food and sleep.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Guilty: Everyone is guilty. Always. Even if they did nothing — especially then. Guilt isn't treated here, it's cultivated. Like potatoes, only more useful.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Bloodfeeding: Blood is the new gold. Prisoners aren't a problem, they're walking bottles. Blood type? Any will do.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Raider: Diplomacy is for those with few bullets. Every enemy corpse is a prayer. Peace is just a pause between raids.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_TreeConnection: A tree is a colonist's best friend. Doesn't argue, doesn't eat, doesn't break furniture. Dryads are its children, and each one whispers thank you. Plant another tree and the forest whispers even louder.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_HumanPrimacy: Humans are the only beings that can forge a masterpiece and then slay a dragon with it. The skill of hands is the ultimate proof of superiority.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Ritualist: Dark rituals aren't a problem, they're a schedule. Monday — summoning. Wednesday — offering. Friday — trying to close the portal opened on Monday. Weekends — praying it doesn't come back.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Individualist: Freedom is the highest value. Freedom from meetings, collective decisions, and people who offer unsolicited advice. Everyone is their own boss, therapist, and motivator.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Loyalist: Betrayal is the worst sin. Loyalty to the colony above all. Deserters and defectors? We don't keep those here.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Inhuman: Humans are the weak link. Machines, mutants, whatever — as long as it's not a regular human. Post-humanism at its finest.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_HAR_Xenophilia: Four arms? Welcome! Tail? Great! Tentacles? Well... okay, come in too. Diversity is key.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_HAR_Xenophobia: Ours is ours. Theirs is theirs. Simple philosophy for simple times. Dissenters get escorted to the map edge. Free of charge.
LanguageData.FT_MemeRecommend_NaturePrimacy: Low wood or food at start
LanguageData.FT_AnimalCompanionPassive: Mood bonus for tamed wild animals in colony
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Rancher: The farm is the heart of the colony. Alpaca — national hero. Chicken — minor saint. Cow — practically a deity. People? People here are just the support staff.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_AnimalPersonhood: Animals are people, only better. They don't complain, don't steal food from the fridge... well actually, they do steal. But we love them anyway.
LanguageData.FT_MemeGameplay_Collectivist: One for all and all for one. Especially when hauling rocks. Personal ambitions? Leave them at the door. What matters here is the result. The collective result.
